listing:promotional_text.back: Scan a page, import a PDF or paste your notes. QuickStudy drafts cards and quizzes for you and shows you only what needs reviewing each day.

listing:keywords.back: flashcards, study, test, spaced repetition, exam, notes, scan, pdf, memorize, civil-service exams (oposiciones)

listing:description.back: QuickStudy turns the pages you already have into cards you will really study. Scan a worksheet, import a PDF or paste your notes, and QuickStudy drafts the cards, links each one to its source and schedules them so you review only what is due. TURN ANY PAGE INTO CARDS: scan pages with the camera, choose a photo, import a PDF or paste text; cards are drafted in the language of your notes; all drafts are kept by default, tap to edit, swipe to remove. STUDY ONLY WHAT IS PENDING TODAY: Today shows you a session with the pending cards, plus your weakest card; spaced repetition moves each card forward as you get it right. DO TESTS IN MINUTES: test-type (multiple-choice) questions with believable incorrect answers; a timer and progress bar keep each session short. UNDERSTAND WHY EACH ANSWER IS CORRECT: each card explains its answer; tap Why? to see the exact passage and page it came from. LEARN FROM EACH MISTAKE: a wrong answer is shown next to the correct one; failed cards come back tomorrow. BUILD A DAILY STUDY HABIT: streaks count the days you study; earn a streak freeze for each complete study week. FOLLOW EACH SUBJECT'S PROGRESS: see how much of each set you have mastered; find the cards you fail most. PRIVATE BY DEFAULT: cards are drafted on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence whenever it is available; if a draft would leave your iPhone, QuickStudy asks you first; cloud drafts use Apple's Private Cloud Compute or the QuickStudy server; the server drafts with Anthropic's Claude, which deletes your text within 30 days; studying, doing tests and editing works offline. FREE AND PRO: QuickStudy includes 10 free AI generations per month; writing your own cards and all study modes are always free and unlimited. QuickStudy Pro adds 150 cloud generations per month on any iPhone. Payment is charged on your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple Account settings.
listing:description.note: "Cuenta de Apple" capitalized (Apple's name); "Administra o cancela" now Spain's "Gestiona o cancela". Factual claims verified.

listing:release_notes.back: QuickStudy 2.0 has been redesigned around studying every day. ONE SESSION A DAY: Today shows only the due cards plus your weakest card; streaks count the days you study and each full study week earns a Streak Freeze. FROM PAGE TO CARDS, FASTER: scan with the camera, choose a photo, import a PDF or paste text; keep using the app while your cards are drafted; every draft is kept by default, tap to edit, swipe to remove. UNDERSTAND WHY: each card links back to the page and passage it came from; every answer explains why it is right, and missed cards come back tomorrow. NOW IN YOUR LANGUAGE: QuickStudy is available in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Portuguese; cards are drafted in the language of your notes, whatever language your iPhone uses; scanning reads pages in those languages and spell-checking follows the language of each page. QUICKSTUDY PRO: an optional subscription with 150 cloud generations a month on any iPhone; typing your own cards and every study mode remain free and unlimited; if a draft would leave your iPhone, QuickStudy asks first.
listing:release_notes.note: Rewritten for 2.0 on 2026-11-12 to cover the whole update, reusing reviewed wording from the description and the in-app What's New. Reviewer found nothing to change. 'sin importar el idioma que use tu iPhone' is slightly Latin American in flavour ('sea cual sea el idioma de tu iPhone' is more peninsular); kept because the earlier reviewed notes used it.
